name: Dusklet · Gremlet #38
description:
A scrap of night sky with a few stars still in it. Gets braver after sunset.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Dusklet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
